title: Amit · Buyer
subtitle: Patil Constructions, Pune. Needs GI pipe for a site.

flags.objection: says the plan is too costly

steps.title: The problem
steps.narration: 80% of buyer enquiries on IndiaMART never get a seller reply. Amit is one of them. Watch what Yaad remembers.

steps.title: Amit searches
steps.narration: Amit searches 'GI pipe 2 inch Pune'. The search carries an mcat, IndiaMART's own key, so a thread is born.

steps.title: He posts a buy-lead
steps.narration: He posts a requirement: 500 pieces, 2 inch, medium class. Same mcat, same thread. The stage moves forward.

steps.title: Two sellers connect
steps.narration: Two sellers buy his lead. One real-world event, written into both sides: Amit's thread and each seller's memory.

steps.title: An enquiry on a sibling mcat
steps.narration: He enquires about fittings. That's a different mcat, but a sibling of GI Pipe, so it joins the same thread instead of starting a new one.

steps.title: A call that didn't connect
steps.narration: He calls the seller. The call has no mcat, but it's the same seller as yesterday's enquiry, so it still lands on the right thread.

steps.title: Yaad calls Amit
steps.narration: Yaad calls Amit. It opens with his unfinished requirement, not a generic greeting. He changes the quantity.
suggest: Quotes WhatsApp pe bhej do kal tak

turns: Namaste Amit ji! Aapki GI Pipe requirement pe 2 sellers jude the, par baat aage nahi badhi. Kya main aur responsive sellers se connect karwa doon?
Haan, par meri requirement thodi change ho gayi hai. Ab 500 nahi, chaar sau piece chahiye.
Ji. Kya main aapki updated requirement responsive sellers ko bhej doon?
Haan, quotes WhatsApp pe bhej do kal tak.
Ji, kal tak quotes WhatsApp pe aa jayenge. Dhanyavaad.

platform_vars.next_step: Send quotes for 400 pcs GI pipe on WhatsApp by tomorrow

steps.title: Next day, on WhatsApp
steps.narration: Next day Amit messages on WhatsApp. The chat picks up where the call stopped. Then he raises a complaint.
suggest: Aur haan, Om Sai Steel ne advance le liya tha, maal nahi bheja

turns: Namaste Amit ji! Pichli baar Phone call pe aapki GI Pipe requirement ki baat hui thi. Usi ka update dene ke liye sampark kiya hai. Baat karein?
Ji, aapke 400 pieces ke liye sellers se quotes aa rahe hain. Kya delivery Pune mein hi chahiye?
Haan. Aur haan, Om Sai Steel ne advance le liya tha, maal nahi bheja.
Bahut afsos hua sunke. Ye GI pipe wale Om Sai Steel Mart ki baat hai na?
Ji, maine complaint support team ko bhej di hai. Quotes kal tak WhatsApp pe aa jayenge.

steps.title: What's underneath
steps.narration: No magic: two API calls. Every step you saw was a real POST /v1/event, and every screen a real GET /v1/context.
